faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Guwahati (AIIMS Guwahati) for filling up research positions under a funded project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by AIIMS Guwahati?
faq.answer: AIIMS Guwahati has advertised for the post of Project Associate I under the Department of Biochemistry for a specific research project.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Project Associate I?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Associate I position in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a postgraduate degree with a minimum of 55% marks in Bioinformatics, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Biological Sciences, or a related discipline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit to apply for this post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Project Associate I position is up to 35 years as per the notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for Project Associate I?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs 29,500/-, which includes Rs 25,000 plus 18% HRA amounting to Rs 4,500.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the completed application form via email is 08-10-2026. Candidates must ensure timely submission.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for AIIMS Guwahati recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly via Email. Candidates need to send their filled application proforma along with documents as a single PDF.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the application email be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be emailed to the official designated email address, which is [email protected], with the required subject line format.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process typically comprises a screening or skill test/written examination followed by a personal interview for shortlisted candidates.
